title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG AND HIS COMPANIONS VENTURE ACROSS THE INDIAN FORESTS, AND WHAT ENSUED
summary_hover: Fogg and his companions cross the Indian forests by elephant and encounter a religious procession preparing to sacrifice a young woman.
summary_detail: Phileas Fogg, Sir Francis Cromarty, and Passepartout travel by elephant through the wild territory of Bundelcund. Their guide leads them through dense forests and over the Vindhia Mountains to bypass the unfinished railway. During their journey, they hide from a passing procession of Brahmins and fakirs who are leading a young drugged woman to a forced suttee sacrifice, prompting Fogg to propose a rescue since he has time to spare.
